note: Masses are catalogue values and prices are indicative USD (hobby market, vary by region and supplier). Weigh each part as you build and update this file; the sizing page and the docs are generated from it.

items.name: Brushless motor 2306, 1900-2300 KV
items.spec: 2306 outrunner, 4S rated, prop adapter, 16x16 or 12x12 mm mount pattern
items.notes: Static thrust is recorded on the thrust stand at Gate 1.

items.name: Propeller 6x3.5 two-blade (spares)
items.spec: 6 in two-blade pusher type (air leaves away from the motor), rotation matched to the motor, balanced
items.notes: Always keep spares: the first crash breaks one.

items.name: Propeller (mounted)
items.notes: Balance with a prop balancer or tape trim.

items.name: ESC 40 A, 4S, DShot (BLHeli_S / AM32)
items.notes: Set motor direction in the configurator before the first spin.

items.name: LiPo 4S 1300 mAh, 75C+, XT60
items.notes: Buy 2-3 packs. Store at 3.8 V per cell.

items.name: Servo BEC 6.0 V / 5 A
items.spec: Switching regulator, input 2S-6S, output 6.0 V >= 5 A peak
items.notes: Four digital servos can pull 3-4 A together at stall.

items.name: Logic BEC 5 V / 3 A
items.spec: Low-noise 5 V for Teensy, IMU, receiver
items.notes: Separate from the servo rail to avoid brown-outs.

items.name: Power leads, XT60 pair, 14 AWG silicone
items.spec: Battery lead to ESC with 1000 uF 35 V low-ESR cap
items.notes: Solder carefully; this is the highest-current joint.

items.name: Arming switch + remove-before-flight loop
items.spec: XT30 loop or anti-spark switch in the battery lead
items.notes: Nothing powers up until the loop is inserted.

items.name: Voltage/current sensor (INA226 breakout)
items.spec: I2C, 36 V, shunt rated >= 40 A, or use ESC telemetry
items.notes: Needed for battery-low cut and power logging.

items.name: Teensy 4.1 (with microSD slot)
items.notes: Same MCU as the rocket: Phase 1 de-risks the software.

items.name: IMU ICM-42688-P breakout
items.notes: Mount on foam standoffs at the CG, away from the motor.

items.name: Barometer BMP390 breakout
items.notes: Cover with open-cell foam against prop-wash noise.

items.name: ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz receiver
items.notes: Needs a matching ELRS transmitter module/radio (ground equipment).

items.name: microSD card 8-32 GB, class 10
items.notes: Logs are how you tune. Never fly without logging.

items.name: Carrier board / perfboard + headers
items.spec: 70x70 mm max, female headers for the Teensy
items.notes: Replace with a custom PCB once the pinout is frozen.

items.name: Buzzer + status LEDs
items.notes: Audible arming state and low-battery alarm.

items.name: Digital metal-gear micro servo (9-13 g)
items.spec: >= 2.0 kg.cm at 6 V, <= 0.10 s/60 deg, 6 V rated, metal gear
items.notes: Matched pairs for roll/pitch are a bonus.

items.name: Vane hinge shaft, steel 2 mm x 110 mm
items.spec: 2 mm drill rod or carbon pin, cut to length
items.notes: Servo horn clamps one end; vane clamps the shaft with an M2 grub screw.

items.name: 3D-printed parts (PETG or PA-CF)
items.spec: Ring, hub, deck, vanes, legs, battery tray (see docs/printing.md)
items.notes: Print legs in TPU or thin PETG for compliance.

items.name: M3 stainless hardware kit + nylock nuts
M3 brass heat-set inserts
items.notes: Use a soldering iron with an insert tip.

items.name: Battery strap 20 mm Velcro + foam pads
Wire: 26-30 AWG silicone, zip ties, heat shrink
Thrust stand: 5 kg load cell + HX711
items.notes: Needed for Gate 1 (static thrust and vane authority).

items.name: Tether kit: 3x 3 m line, ground anchors, swivel
items.notes: Slack tether limits altitude and sideways drift.

items.name: Polycarbonate shield or net cage
items.spec: Between operator and prop on the bench
items.notes: Props at 15k rpm shed blades.

items.name: Current-limited bench supply or smoke stopper
items.spec: Limit to 2-3 A for first power-up
items.notes: Protects against wiring shorts.

items.name: ELRS transmitter / radio
items.spec: Any EdgeTX radio with an ELRS module
items.notes: Skip if you already own one.
